sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Machine Learning in Medical Imaging》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Advances in both imaging and computers have synergistically led to a rapid rise in the potential use of artificial intelligence in various radiological imaging tasks, such as risk assessment, detection, diagnosis, prognosis, and therapy response, as well as in multi-omics disease discovery.
